newsitem.title: USA: Ronson extends exchange offer to June 19.
newsitem.headline: Ronson extends exchange offer to June 19.

text.p: Ronson Corp said Friday its exchange offer to owners of its 12 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock has been extended to June 19 from its May 16 expiration date.
Ronson said it has offered to exchange shares of common stock at the rate of 1.7 shares of common for each share of preferred.
The company said all other terms of the exchange offer remain the same.
Ronson said it has received and accepted about 79 percent of the preferred shares for exchange under the terms and conditions of the offer.
Ronson said all future preferred shares tendered prior to the expiration of the exchange offer will be accepted.
After acceptance of the preferred shares and the issuing of common shares in exchange, the company has about 2,929,000 million shares of common stock outstanding.
